# Draft:Mouse Kingdom Liqueurs

Mouse Kingdom Liqueurs is a UK based independently owned distillery producing since 2022.
Production
All of their liqueurs are made with a base spirit of UK grown winter wheat alcohol, and hand made in central Manchester with batch sizes varying from 100-300 Litres.
Awards
Mouse Kingdom Liqueurs has earned gold medals from the Class Magazine Bartenders Brand awards Competition. In 2023 their Dark Berries won the liqueur category. In 2025 their 16% abv Strawberry & Balsamic Liqueur placed second
